caption:
Claimed free ChatGPT Go last November? Your free year is ending or already over, so check your renewal date today.

The offer gave Indian users 12 months free. The normal price is Rs 399 a month, and reports at launch said billing starts automatically after the free period.

Open your plan page, note the date, set a reminder. Terms can change, so trust your account page over any post, ours included.

Source: Deccan Herald, Nov 2025.

Save this and send it to a friend who claimed it.
